description: Department of Local Government - Northern Province - Notify to convene the meeting of Delft Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the convening of a meeting for the election to fill vacancies for Chairman and Vice Chairman of a local authority (Delft Pradeshiya Sabha). It specifically references the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act and deals with electoral processes at the local government level, making it a clear example of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
